# Lunar Hare

> Hair salon & barber based in Bloomington, Indiana. A plant-filled salon and barber chair in downtown Bloomington. Cuts, curly cuts, color, shaves and updos from a stylist who listens first, plus a shampoo and head massage people come back for.

- Phone: (812) 340-5052
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Spencer, Martinsville, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.9 from 38 reviews

## Services
- Cuts & long layers: Long, mid-length and short cuts shaped around how you actually wear your hair, plus child cuts for 12 and under.
- Custom curly cuts: Deva-certified curly cuts that coax natural curl out, with tips for your routine at home.
- Color & balayage: Soft, detailed balayage and highlights, rich all-over shades and bold fashion color.
- Barber cuts & shaves: Fades and short cuts in a real barber chair, plus hot-towel, straight-razor shaves.
- Blowouts, updos & extensions: Special-occasion styling with a trial a week before, blowouts, and extensions that move naturally.
- Treatments, tints & waxing: A Malibu treatment for dry, dull, chlorine-tired hair, brow and lash tints, and face waxing.

## About
Lunar Hare is Jayme Carney's salon at 236 N Morton St in downtown Bloomington. She opened it in 2021 "with hopes of growing and here we are!" Jayme is a licensed barber and cosmetologist, trained in classic cuts and classic color at the TIGI Academy in Manhattan, Deva certified, with advanced curly-cut training in Chicago. Inside it's warm and lived-in: stained concrete floors, vintage armchairs, a floral front counter, a teal sofa (usually with the salon dog on it), a pink cabinet and plants on every shelf. It's a Green Circle certified salon, and clients say it best: a down-to-earth, welcoming vibe, a stylist who listens, and a wash and head massage worth the trip on its own.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book at Lunar Hare?
  A: Book online through our booking page any time, or call (812) 340-5052. We're at 236 N Morton St in downtown Bloomington.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Wednesday 12 to 8 pm, Friday 10 am to 6 pm and Saturday 10 am to 4 pm. Closed Sunday, Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.
- Q: Do you cut curly hair?
  A: Yes. Jayme is Deva certified, with advanced curly-cut training in Chicago. A custom curly cut starts at $75.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Child cuts (12 and younger) start at $35, and reviewers mention stylists gently coaxing a six-year-old through a haircut.
- Q: Do you do fades and shaves?
  A: Yes. Jayme is a licensed barber too: short cuts, fades, beard trims, traditional straight-razor shaves and hot lather head shaves.
- Q: What's your cancellation policy?
  A: Please give 24 hours' notice. Cancellations within 24 hours are charged 50% of the appointment, and after three cancellations in a row we ask for a non-refundable deposit.
